title: mastermind.indicator/v1
description: One doc per {indicator, symbol, timeframe}. The series/gates/bars arrays are CHART-ONLY and must never be sent to the model — use signal_layer.contracts.model_slice() to project the model-facing surface (signals + state + honest_read).

source_hash.description: sha256 over script source AND the full params block

macd_kind.description: REQUIRED; insufficient alone — params carries the lengths

signal_era.description: THE SIGNAL-ERA FENCE. Which entry rule produced these signals, so pre- and post-change events are never pooled into one track record. "gc_v2" = the pre-fence rule (enter = (CB|revBuy) & ~bear_block). "gc_v2_wo1" = that rule plus the ratified washout-override conditional (enter = (CB|revBuy) & (~bear_block | override_ok); Macro Dashboard research/BLOCKED_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL_PREREG.md §4/§5 at the 25% notch). ADDITIVE: a doc carrying no signal_era at all predates the fence and must be read as "gc_v2" — never default a missing era to the current one. Changing the notch is itself an era event.

series.description: CHART-ONLY numeric series aligned to bars

gates.description: CHART-ONLY boolean regime series aligned to bars

ts.description: ISO date used to place the event on its chart bar (the 3D bar open)

known_ts.description: ISO session date when the event became observable; defaults to ts for legacy events

price.description: Point-in-time marker price. SELL = the DAILY close of the confirm session itself (the close that broke stop_level); BUY/REBUY/RECLAIM = their 3D row close. Never a bar that closes after the event's own date.

basis.description: What machine produced the event. Present on SELL only: every user-facing SELL is a TRAILING STRUCTURE STOP (armed distribution + a daily close below the last confirmed radius-3 swing low), not a momentum/oracle exit. Absent = no basis published for that event kind. Readers must not infer a momentum exit from a bare type:'SELL'.

stop_level.description: SELL only: the confirmed swing low whose break triggered the stop.

blocked.description: Present (and true) ONLY on an entry the v2 regime gate REFUSED (bear_block). The type field still reads BUY/REBUY for back-compat, so this flag — not type — is the render and scoring key: a blocked setup must never be drawn with buy geometry, never enter a Buy panel state or latest-signal card, and never walk position_hint.

quality.description: keeper verdict: take | block | pending | regime_blocked (see blocked) | override_take. "override_take" is NOT a keeper verdict: it is the washout-override ENTRY class (signal_era gc_v2_wo1) — a bear_block-vetoed fire the live enter mask took because the name's thematic-basket peers sat at/below the ratified notch on the day it fired. It bypasses the keeper's counter-trend reclaim-and-hold leg by design (the gauntleted construction enters on the fire itself), carries override_ctx and a recipe tier, never carries the blocked flag, and is a REAL scored entry: it walks position_hint, anchors the verdict, and fires alerts.

tier.description: recipe tier: aplus | quality | base; null on a blocked entry. Present on an override_take fire — the recipe score carries no counter-trend leg, so it is the same tier an unvetoed fire on that bar would have had.

scored.description: RECLAIM only: false = pre-promotion display-tier marker.

override_candidate.description: DISPLAY TIER ONLY. Present (and true) only on a quality="regime_blocked" fire whose thematic-basket peers were >=25% below their 252d highs on the day it fired (ratified 2026-08-10; Macro Dashboard research/BLOCKED_ENTRY_RATIFICATION_PACKET_2026-08-10.md). It changes the MARKER and the rail card only: the entry mask, keeper verdict, tier, score, and backtest are untouched, and the event stays a refusal. Never set on a keeper "block" (a different refusal, outside the studied cohort). Stamped point-in-time by signal_layer/washout_override.py from the basket state current at the fire, so it is never a backfill of today's state onto history.

override_ctx.description: Why the override applied, as known at the fire: group_id (thematic basket or GICS sector fallback), peer_dd (peer-median 252d drawdown, NEGATIVE fraction, leave-one-out basis), basis ("basket"|"sector"), thresholds_hit, as_of (the basket-state date), and the basket's display name/name_zh so the card needs no second fetch. Rides BOTH classes: the display-tier override_candidate refusal, and the override_take entry.

state.description: MODEL-FACING one-row read the picker ranks on

last_scored_ts.description: Availability date of the last scored signal (known_ts, with legacy fallback to ts)

extended.description: DEPRECATED MISNOMER — carries strong_bull, NOT overbought, and is unrelated to the Macro Dashboard cycles 'Extended - don't chase' caution. Read strong_bull or overbought by name instead. Retained only for pre-2026-07-15 consumers.

last_scored_basis.description: basis of the signal that set position_hint. 'structure_stop' on a flat means the position was stopped out on a swing-low break, not exited on momentum.

strong_bull.description: weekly + monthly bull and above the 200d - a trend-STRENGTH read.

overbought.description: the true Pine extendedNow on the last 3D row: RSI>=70 or %K>=80.
